evidence.claim: TreeHouse Foods describes itself as a leading private-brands snacking and beverage manufacturer in North America and says it is the supply chain for its customers' brands, with 26 US production facilities.

SPS Commerce's 2025 10-K says it operates a global supply-chain network connecting retailers, brands, distributors, manufacturers, and logistics providers; 2025 revenue was $751.5 million and recurring revenue was 96% of total revenue.
SPS Commerce reported that its largest customer represented less than 1% of total revenue in 2025, 2024, and 2023, reducing single-customer fatal dependency risk.
Seneca Foods states it supplies almost every US retailer and operates across farming, food processing, seed breeding and research, can manufacturing, and distribution.
Seneca says its vertically integrated position helps it meet industry standards and maintain quality across operations.

Mission Produce's 2025 10-K says it sources, produces, packs and distributes avocados, and provides value-added services including ripening, bagging, custom packaging, logistical management, and quality assurance.
Mission Produce says it primarily markets avocados to retail, wholesale, and foodservice customers and focuses on delivering quality avocados on time and within customer specifications.

memory_update.text: THS is the cleanest direct reference candidate for private-label packaged food manufacturing capacity, but later layers must test execution, recall risk, retailer concentration, and margin conversion.

SPSC should be tracked as a second-order retailer-supplier compliance network candidate; the key thesis is not private-label manufacturing but retailer integration, supplier onboarding, compliance logic, and order/fulfillment data complexity.
SENEA is a low-attention vertically integrated affordable food processor with potential value-channel/private-label relevance; verify private-label mix and large-retailer dependence before promotion.

AVO maps to perishables logistics, ripening, custom packaging, and retailer specification fulfillment; treat as a hypothesis because commodity avocado price and sourcing risk may dominate the chokepoint signal.

Need next-pass search for US-listed packaging suppliers, food-safety/testing labs, cold-chain REITs/logistics, and off-price retail logistics vendors with explicit Walmart/Costco/Aldi/dollar-store/private-label exposure.

summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed candidates one or two steps away from the obvious value-retail winners. The strongest direct reference name is TreeHouse Foods as a private-brand snacking and beverage manufacturer. The underfollowed lane adds SPS Commerce as retailer-supplier compliance/connectivity infrastructure, Seneca Foods as vertically integrated affordable fruit/vegetable processing and packaging capacity, and Mission Produce as fresh-produce ripening, custom packaging, logistics, and retailer-specification fulfillment infrastructure.
